TEQUILA TOWN — PRESS PACK

CONTENTS
Logos: horizontal wordmark, white and dark, in SVG and transparent PNG (2400 px wide).
Fonts: TEQUILATOWN Regular and Qut'n'torn Regular, with original copyright notices.
Photography: four venue photographs, JPEG, up to 2400 px on the longest side.
Fact sheet: venue description, address, contact details and websites.
Website palette: colors used on the main site.

USAGE
Use the supplied logo artwork with its original proportions and clear contrast against its background. Do not stretch or redraw it. Photography credit: Courtesy of Tequila Town. For additional attribution details, alternate formats, interviews or commercial-use enquiries, contact hi@tequila.town. Font copyright notices are in fonts/NOTICES.txt.
